column1: # The files pytest loads before every test (lib/test_closure.py Closure.base) and how the land
# gate judges a change to each (tests/_carry_shadow.py `choose`, the test-once design 2.3,
# GOH.CARRYBASECODE). One row per file, <path><TAB><class>; tests/test_base_table.py keeps it whole.
#   suite-wide  pytest's own start reads it whole (its configuration, a conftest.py, the workflow
#               the suite takes its environment from): nothing carries across it
#   load-read   data the base opens as it loads: every test reads it, nothing carries
#   base-code   judged by its readers; the idle suite and the ship's full run are its backstop
# A base file with no row is wide until it is classed here.
